notes.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice
notes.content:
[h2][b]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice[/b][/h2][p]Hello. This is the [i]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World[/i] development team.[/p][p]In this update, we focused on adjusting elements related to mid-boss progression, projectile pattern correction, weapon visibility improvement, and stage event enhancements. These changes aim to improve combat flow and overall usability.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Update Details[/h3][list][*][p][b]Improved mid-boss re-entry path[/b]
Once players enter a mid-boss battle and clear it once, the entrance key will now respawn closer to the boss area for subsequent attempts.
Additionally, teleport points or shortcuts will now appear to reduce unnecessary travel time on retries.[/p][/*][*][p][b]1st Chapter mid-boss projectile skill pattern fix[/b]
We have corrected an issue where the projectile skill used by the first mid-boss in Chapter 1 would fly off at irregular angles.
It now fires at consistent angles, allowing players to more clearly anticipate and respond to attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player weapon size increased[/b]
The size of player-held weapons has been increased across the board.
This improves visual clarity of attack range and makes directional targeting easier to read during combat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]3-6 stage switch interaction camera update[/b]
In Chapter 3, Stage 6, a camera movement (Timeline) sequence has been added to show the position of the floor created through switch interaction.
This helps players clearly understand what was triggered and where the newly generated platform appears.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We are always working to make [i]Slayer[/i] a more refined and strategically engaging action experience.
Your feedback continues to guide us, and we remain committed to bringing you ongoing improvements and new content.[/p][p]Thank you.
— [i]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World[/i] Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Details
notes.content:
[h2]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Details[/h2][p]Hello,
This is the development team of [i]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World[/i].[/p][p]In this update, we focused on enhancing immersion through additional dialogue in the tutorial and world map, introduced two new items related to falling hazards, and rebalanced projectile DOT (damage-over-time) mechanics.[/p][p]Though this is a relatively small-scale patch, we consider it a meaningful step toward expanding what makes Slayer unique — offering strategic, high-tension gameplay experiences.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p][b]1. Added dialogue to the tutorial and world map[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new line of dialogue has been added to the [b]guard at the end of the tutorial[/b], offering a short in-universe guide before players move forward.[/p][/*][*][p]Additional [b]guard NPCs at the sea gates on the world map[/b] now feature dialogue as well, adding atmosphere and narrative context to exploration.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. New Item: Wings of Salvation[/b][/p][list][*][p]To reduce the frustration caused by instant game-overs from falls, we’ve added the [b]“Wings of Salvation”[/b] item.[/p][/*][*][p]If the player possesses this item, it automatically activates upon falling to restore them to their last position before the fall.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. New Item: Graven Sole[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’ve also added [b]“Graven Sole,”[/b] which [b]prevents all falls in the stage[/b] where it is used.[/p][/*][*][p]This item is particularly useful in maps with high verticality and will enable more strategic planning and survivability.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]4. Projectile DOT Damage Adjustment[/b][/p][list][*][p]We fixed an issue where projectile-based damage-over-time effects were applying lower-than-intended damage.[/p][/*][*][p]These values have now been corrected, and [b]DOT-based skills and weapons will be more effective as a result.[/b][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Looking Ahead[/h3][p]We continue to monitor gameplay feedback and data closely in our ongoing effort to improve the combat feel and overall immersion of Slayer.[/p][p]The highly anticipated [b]Fallen Mode[/b] is actively in development.
It will introduce a [b]fully restructured map[/b], new enemies, expanded story branches, and high-difficulty content worthy of a major update.[/p][p]We are also preparing improvements to controls, new boss patterns, and expanded skill tree systems — all of which we’ll share more about in the near future.[/p][hr][/hr][p]We extend our deepest thanks to everyone who continues to play and support Slayer.
Your feedback and encouragement are what drive us forward.
We are committed to making Slayer deeper, more polished, and more rewarding with every update.[/p][p]Thank you,
— [i]The Slayer: The Demon Haunted World Dev Team[/i][/p]

tags.feature: A new line of dialogue has been added to the guard at the end of the tutorial, offering a short in-universe guide before players move forward.
Additional guard NPCs at the sea gates on the world map now feature dialogue as well, adding atmosphere and narrative context to exploration.
To reduce the frustration caused by instant game-overs from falls, we’ve added the “Wings of Salvation” item.
If the player possesses this item, it automatically activates upon falling to restore them to their last position before the fall.
We’ve also added “Graven Sole,” which prevents all falls in the stage where it is used.

tags.bug: We fixed an issue where projectile-based damage-over-time effects were applying lower-than-intended damage.

tags.balance_change: These values have now been corrected, and DOT-based skills and weapons will be more effective as a result.

notes.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice
notes.content:
[h2]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice[/h2][p]Hello, players.
[b]Slayer: The Demon Haunted World[/b] is evolving constantly.
Our development team is working hard [b]every day[/b] to improve the experience for all of you who enjoy the game.
In this update, we’ve applied various fixes and improvements based on your valuable feedback.
Here are the full patch details:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]UI and Convenience Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Added X Button to Mode Selection Panel[/b]
We have added a close (X) button to the mode selection UI on the main menu, improving [b]user convenience and intuitive control[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fixed Overlapping Level-Up UI Elements[/b]
When leveling up for the first time, the character status panel, level-up tutorial message, and damage numbers no longer overlap visually.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stat Tutorial Box Behavior Adjusted[/b]
The guidance box in the stat tutorial now [b]disappears automatically after assigning stat points[/b], eliminating confusion for new players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Inventory Gold Visibility[/b]
[b]Adjusted font size and color[/b] of the gold display in the inventory UI to make it more legible.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Combat and Game System Improvements[/h3][list][*][p][b]Parry Tutorial Level Redesigned[/b]
To help players focus better on learning the parry system, we have redesigned the level layout.
The tutorial monster’s HP is now removed, and when the player tries to attack, [b]a parry guide message appears[/b] to encourage proper response.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Extended Parry Window[/b]
We slightly [b]increased the parry timing window[/b] for enemy attacks, lowering the difficulty of parrying and improving accessibility for newer players.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Torch Interactions Improved[/b]
You can now [b]deal at least minimal damage to all objects using the torch[/b].
For objects that do not respond to fire-based damage-over-time effects, a [b]message prompts players to switch to a weapon[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Critical Hit Visuals[/b]
[b]Critical hit effects have been upgraded with more vivid particles[/b] to emphasize impact and visual flair.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Terminology and Visual Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Mode Name Changes[/b]
We renamed the game modes for better clarity:[/p][list][*][p]“Casual” is now “Action”[/p][/*][*][p]“Standard” is now “Master”[/p][/*][*][p]“Hell Mode” is now “Hardcore”
This change helps better reflect the [b]intent and challenge level[/b] of each mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]World Map Visibility Extended[/b]
The [b]world map view range has been expanded[/b], making navigation and direction-finding easier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Treasure Chest Rewards Guaranteed[/b]
We removed the chance of treasure chests giving no rewards.
You will now [b]always receive at least gold[/b] when opening a chest.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Scenario and Visual Presentation Updates[/h3][list][*][p][b]Fade-out Effect When Skipping Opening Scene[/b]
Skipping the opening scenario now includes a [b]fade-out transition[/b] for smoother presentation.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Our team is deeply grateful to everyone who has supported Slayer.
We are fully committed to delivering a game that is [b]not only stylish and strategic[/b], but also continuously improving based on community feedback.[/p][p]If you’ve joined the Slayer journey already, thank you.
If not, now is the perfect time.[/p][p][b]We are building this world every day—for your enjoyment.[/b]
See you in the tower.[/p][p]— The Slayer Development Team[/p]

When leveling up for the first time, the character status panel, level-up tutorial message, and damage numbers no longer overlap visually.

The guidance box in the stat tutorial now [b]disappears automatically after assigning stat points[/b], eliminating confusion for new players.

[b]Adjusted font size and color[/b] of the gold display in the inventory UI to make it more legible.

To help players focus better on learning the parry system, we have redesigned the level layout.
The tutorial monster’s HP is now removed, and when the player tries to attack, [b]a parry guide message appears[/b] to encourage proper response.

You can now [b]deal at least minimal damage to all objects using the torch[/b].
For objects that do not respond to fire-based damage-over-time effects, a [b]message prompts players to switch to a weapon[/b].

[b]Enhanced Critical Hit Visuals[/b]
[b]Critical hit effects have been upgraded with more vivid particles[/b] to emphasize impact and visual flair.

[b]World Map Visibility Extended[/b]

[b]Treasure Chest Rewards Guaranteed[/b]

notes.title: 🛠️ [Major Update Notice] – New Game Modes & System Improvements!
notes.content:
[h2]🛠️ \[Major Update Notice] – New Game Modes & System Improvements![/h2][p]Hello, this is the [b]Slayer: The Demon-Haunted World[/b] development team![/p][p]We’re excited to bring you one of our biggest updates yet — introducing [b]new game modes[/b], exciting system upgrades, and gameplay improvements based on your valuable feedback. Whether you enjoy strategic combat, fast-paced action, or roguelike challenges, there's something new for everyone![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 New Game Modes Added![/h3][p]🧠 Standard Mode (formerly "Tactical")[/p][p]This is the [b]core Slayer experience[/b] — a strategic action RPG that emphasizes [b]precise movement[/b], [b]timing[/b], and [b]unique parry mechanics[/b]. Use your surroundings and stamina wisely to overcome intense challenges.[/p][p]⚔️ Casual Mode – Stylish & Fast![/p][p]For players who love [b]faster, freer combat[/b], Casual Mode allows you to attack in [b]all directions[/b] without restrictions. No need to worry about strict movement — enjoy the thrill of fast-paced action![/p][p]🔥 Hell Mode – Roguelike Challenge![/p][p]Hardcore adventurers, this is for you! In Hell Mode, you only get a [b]limited number of lives[/b]. Lose them all, and it's back to the beginning.
Each run is a test of skill, and [b]we’ll be adding time records in future updates[/b] to track your ultimate Slayer journey![/p][hr][/hr][h3]🧱 Update Highlights[/h3][list][*][p]🛡️ Increased the drop rate of shields from chests.[/p][/*][*][p]🚶‍♀️ Added an [b]Eliya animation[/b] beneath the loading bar that shows her moving toward the next stage.[/p][/*][*][p]🌳 [b]Wooden floor tiles[/b] now show different colors based on how close they are to breaking.[/p][/*][*][p]🔥 [b]Brazier buffs[/b] now last [b]60 seconds[/b], giving you more time to benefit from their power.[/p][/*][*][p]🆕 Added [b]Casual Mode[/b] and [b]Hell Mode[/b] to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]🧭 Casual Mode enables [b]freedom of movement and rotation in all four directions[/b] for stylish and explosive gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]☠️ In Hell Mode, battle with [b]limited lives[/b] — once they're gone, you must start from the beginning![/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]We’re constantly refining Slayer to give you a better, deeper experience — whether you’re here for the strategy or the spectacle.[/p][p][b]Try out the new modes and tell us what you think![/b]
Thank you for your continued support. More great content is coming soon![/p][p]— Slayer Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: [Update Notice]
notes.content:
[Update Notice] – Resolution Settings Save, Parry System Improvements & Mode Name Changes
Hello, this is the Slayer development team.

In this update, we've improved the saving of user settings, enhanced the parry system for better responsiveness, and updated the names of game modes.

System Settings Improvement
Resolution and fullscreen settings now load correctly from saved values at game start and are accurately reflected in the options UI.

Parry System Enhancements
Based on feedback from the Play Expo exhibition, we've increased the parry window duration.

Added a visual cue where enemy platforms gradually turn red as their attack timing approaches, making it easier to anticipate parry timing.

Game Mode Name Changes
Renamed the previous "Tactical" mode to "Standard".

Renamed the previous "Standard" mode to "Casual".

We will continue to strive for a more comfortable gaming experience.
Thank you.

— Slayer Dev Team

notes.content:
🛠️ [Update Notice] – Steam Deck Compatibility & New Chapter Content
Hello, this is the Slayer development team!
In this update, we’ve improved Steam Deck compatibility and added exciting new chapter mechanics. Please see the full patch notes below.

✅ Steam Deck Improvements
We’ve officially verified device behavior for Steam Deck and adjusted the tutorial intro to display as an image (instead of video) to resolve playback issues.

Adjusted visual compatibility to ensure images render properly on Steam Deck models.

🕹️ New Chapter Content
Added a new spider web trap mechanic in Chapter 1.

Introduced a rotating statue puzzle that players must escape from in Chapter 2.

⚙️ New Tutorial Skip Feature
Players can now skip the tutorial from the main settings menu and during mode selection.

Tutorial skip is only available when starting from a new slot.

We hope these changes make your Slayer experience even smoother and more immersive — whether you're playing on desktop or on Steam Deck.
Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

— Slayer Dev Team

Hello, this is the Slayer development team!

This update addresses a save issue and includes several improvements to the tutorial and stamina mechanics.

✅ Patch Highlights
Fixed a bug that prevented saving in the previous update.

Removed the tutorial skip feature temporarily as it is being redesigned.

When holding a torch, stamina consumption while moving is now reduced by half.

Added detailed explanations of parry and torch mechanics in the tutorial.

Removed stamina loss on attack, as it caused players to stand still during recovery, leading to overly static gameplay.

We’ll keep working to improve Slayer and make it more enjoyable.
Thanks for playing!

— Slayer Dev Team

notes.title: [Update Notice] – UI Fixes & Big Update Teaser
notes.content:
[b][Update Notice] – UI Fixes & Big Update Teaser[/b]
Hello, this is the Slayer development team!
We’ve made several quality-of-life improvements and are preparing for a major upcoming update.
Here are the details:

 Fixes & Improvements
The story scene can now be progressed by mouse click for smoother control.

On the main menu, adjusting sound settings will now correctly affect the trailer volume and prologue rain sounds.

Added new UI click sound effects for better feedback.

Upcoming Major Update Preview
A huge update is on the way!
We’re excited to share that the following new gameplay modes are currently in development:

 Tactical Mode – Featuring Slayer’s unique directional combat system
 Standard Mode – Allows free 360° attacks for fast-paced, exhilarating action
 Hardcore Mode (coming later) – One death = game over. True challenge awaits.

We’re working hard to make Slayer more fun and more versatile than ever.
Stay tuned, and thank you always for playing.
Have a great week!

— Slayer Dev Team

notes.content:
🛠️ [Update Notice] – UI Improvements, Stage Adjustments & Stability Enhancements
Hello everyone,
This update focuses on helping new players adapt early on, while also improving system stability and visual clarity across the game.

🔰 Gameplay & Stage Adjustments
Removed fall zones in early stages
To help players focus on movement and basic attacks, fall hazards have been removed from early stages.

Torch signpost repositioned
The location of the torch tutorial sign has been adjusted for better flow and visibility.

🎮 UI & Visual Updates
ESC menu now shows clearer stage order
The UI has been updated to improve the visibility of your current stage from the pause menu.

Main UI icons updated with pixel style
Major interface icons have been redesigned in pixel art style for consistency and style.

Loading screen added after trailer
A new loading screen now appears after the opening trailer for smoother transition.

⚙️ System & Balance Improvements
Base stamina increased + agility stat enhanced
We've raised base stamina and strengthened the impact of agility points for more dynamic combat pacing.

Fixed tutorial mute issue
Resolved an issue where tutorial audio was not playing in certain cases.

General system optimization & stability
Improved overall performance for smoother gameplay.

Thanks as always for your support!

— The Slayer Dev Team

Thank you for playing, and we’ll continue improving Slayer based on your feedback!

Hello everyone, this is the Slayer: The Demon Haunted World dev team.
This update includes adjustments to tutorials, skill slot behavior, UI controls, and monster balancing.

✅ Update Highlights
Removed potion tutorial from Tutorial 1

Removed spike trap near the key in Tutorial 6 to ease difficulty

World map: fixed issue where pressing left/right keys while a popup is open would still move the selection

Improved behavior when registering a skill to a quickslot that already contains another skill:

Previously, the existing skill was deleted

Now, the existing skill is automatically shifted to an adjacent slot

Increased scroll sensitivity in developer commentary

Adjusted monster types and placement to better match overall balance

Thank you for your continued support!
– The Slayer Dev Team
